doc.summary: Centralised subprocess wrapper for the LazyOwn framework.
doc.description:
Provides safe, logged command execution as a replacement for bare
:func:`os.system` and unguarded :func:`subprocess.run` calls.

Contracts
---------
1. :func:`safe_run` executes a command via the system shell, logs the
   invocation, enforces a timeout, and returns a
   :class:`subprocess.CompletedProcess`.
2. :func:`run_shell` is a convenience wrapper that returns stdout as a
   string (or raises on failure).
3. Every command is logged at INFO level with the PID and exit code.

Usage
-----
    from core.executor import safe_run, run_shell

    result = safe_run(["nmap", "-sS", target], timeout=60)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        print(result.stderr)

    output = run_shell("ls -la /tmp", timeout=10)

Config keys owned: none.

name: safe_run
signature: def safe_run(command: str | list[str], *, timeout: int = 300) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]

doc.summary: Execute a command with logging and timeout.
doc.description:
List input uses ``shell=False``. String input keeps ``shell=True``
for legacy pipelines and requires caller sanitisation.

Security:
    List form never touches shell. String form intentionally uses
    shell; callers must sanitise user-controlled input.
    Null-byte injection is rejected.

params.name: command
params.description: A shell command string or list of argv tokens.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Maximum execution time in seconds (1-3600, default 300).

returns.description:
A :class:`subprocess.CompletedProcess` with ``stdout`` and
``stderr`` captured as strings.

raises.name: ValueError
raises.description: If *command* is empty, contains null bytes, or timeout is out of range.

name: run_shell
signature: def run_shell(cmd: str, *, timeout: int = 300) -> str

doc.summary: Execute a shell command and return its stdout.
doc.description:
A convenient wrapper over :func:`safe_run` that raises on non-zero
exit codes.

Security:
    See :func:`safe_run` security note.

params.name: cmd
params.description: The shell command string to execute.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Maximum execution time in seconds (1-3600, default 300).

returns.description: Captured stdout with leading/trailing whitespace stripped.

raises.name: subprocess.CalledProcessError
raises.description: If the command exits with a non-zero return code.
